0022600124.text: The Oklahoma City Thunder (2-0, 1st in the Northwest, 3rd in the West) host the Phoenix Suns (1-1, 2nd in the Pacific, 1.5 games back, 9th in the West), and the Thunder enter on a two-game winning streak. Oklahoma City won the 2025-26 regular-season series 3-2 and swept the 2025-26 playoff series 4-0, with the most recent meeting a 131-122 Thunder win in Phoenix in the playoffs on April 27, and the two teams have not yet played each other in 2026-27. Oklahoma City is missing Nikola Topic (out, back surgery), Otega Oweh (out, Achilles surgery), and Thomas Sorber (out, knee surgery), while Phoenix is without Mark Williams (out, shoulder surgery) and has Oso Ighodaro listed as day-to-day with an oblique strain, a game-time decision.
